notes.title: Summer update now available!
notes.notes:
Hello investigators. 

The Summer update for Mythos: The Beginning is now live, featuring some quality of life upgrades and a couple of small balance tweaks.

This update includes the following changes:
Optimised screen rendering code. Tearing and flickering should be less common on certain machines.
Windowed mode will now automatically scale to your native desktop resolution, while maintaining aspect ratio.
Added a new "Story Mode" difficulty setting due to popular demand. Stats of all enemies are reduced by 50% on this setting.
Made enemies slightly weaker on all difficulty settings.

notes.title: OS X version now available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone.

We're happy to announce that the Mac port of Mythos: The Beginning is now available, thanks to the efforts of the team over at Jammed Gears Studios!

Porting a game made in RPG Maker VX Ace to non-Windows systems is no easy task but after several months of trial and error and a lot of very tedious testing, we've succeeded in creating a version of the game that will run on most Mac systems. As a developer who primarily works with Windows systems, we were really out of our comfort zone trying to test the game on the many variations of OS X out there, but we're confident that we've managed to deliver an experience as close to the original Windows version as possible.

The Jammed Gears team have been developing Mac ports of RPG Maker games for over 2 years and are responsible for the OS X version of the cult classic Yume Nikki, so we think Mythos is in good hands.

Happy (Mac) sleuthing!

notes.title: 1.1b Patch is now live!
notes.notes:
Greetings investigators! Today a new patch for Mythos: The Beginning went live, fixing a few minor (and not so minor) issues that were reported by the playerbase.

This fixes in this patch include:

- Meeting Peter in the morgue will now correctly prevent you from also meeting him in the library.
- Some text rewritten to make better use of available space.
- Some Steamworks adjustments.

notes.title: Holiday patch available!
notes.notes:
Happy holidays, Mythos fans!

A brand new update for Mythos: The Beginning is now available, including some long-awaited performance and stability tweaks and some additional balancing based on player feedback.

This new patch includes:


Various performance and stability tweaks.
If you decide to leave the asylum after finding certain clues, your character will now acknowledge Blacktail's involvement.
When talking to Blake Bell, there is a new dialogue option to acknowledge Blacktail's involvement if you've read the Watchman's Diary.
Late game EXP costs have been increased to prevent characters from becoming too powerful.
Early game monsters have been made easier to fight, while late game monsters have been made harder.
You now get less EXP when selling unwanted supplies than before.
Increased the yield of healing items on Casual difficulty.

notes.title: Director's Cut DLC Release
notes.notes:
Hi all.

The free Director's Cut DLC for Mythos: The Beginning will soon be live on Steam, adding a number of player requested features and general polishes to the game.

This huge update includes the following additions:


Two new mid-game monsters, the Long Neck and the Flesh Eater.
New puzzle solutions and ways to bypass obstacles.
New skill checks have been added throughout the game, giving you more opportunities to use your character's Talents.
EXP system has been slightly tweaked.
Support for Steam Trading Cards (to be available very soon).


This DLC will download automatically the next time you launch Mythos. After the update is completed, your game should be version 1.0.0 DC.

notes.title: Mythos version 1.5 now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. We've got another small patch available for Mythos: The Beginning this week that fixes a few small bugs and adds a new feature that has been often requested by our playerbase.

The list of changes in this update includes:

- Notebooks will no longer be consumed if you cancel out of the save screen.
- Increased the detection area for many objects. Interaction should generally feel a lot smoother now.
- Fixed some typos present in late game dialogue.
- Escaping from the gas trap room no longer leaves the screen with a permanent green tint.

This patch should automatically download when you launch the game in Steam, provided you have automatic updates enabled.
